title: [releases/v0.32.0rc][MRV2][Performance] Enable Qwen CPU length optimization by default (#20327)
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Backport the same five-file Qwen feature delta from #20327 (`ddf8e788caf3a4d719294913cfc3b0842bfe2dc9`) to `releases/v0.32.0rc`. Existing differences between the upstream branches are preserved.

Based on upstream `ccdf1383df3debdd31fff3456b01942b509b8a60`, with one feature commit to preserve the current CI source/workflow snapshot.

Audited Qwen3.8 Flash Next Model Runner V2 consumers automatically skip the redundant exact-count D2H copy and synchronized CPU mirror update. Exact positions, execution lengths, KV slots and accepted recurrent state remain device-based, following the existing paired exemption used by DeepSeek4.1.

The capability is enabled by default without an additional-config flag or environment variable. AscendConfig has no changes in this PR.

Eligibility is still checked once after KV initialization: exact Qwen model-state/native MTP types, resolved Qwen target architecture, and all audited QSA/GDN/PLE target and draft backend-builder pairs. Unknown consumers, context parallelism, sparse KV offload and realtime media retain exact CPU synchronization; the runner's PP guard still has priority. Text and ordinary non-realtime multimodal requests share this capability.

The model state drains the previous copy stream once before enabling the exemption and freezes the result for its initialized lifetime. The shared runner receives only eight added lines for optional model-state initialization and capability lookup. Existing D2H producer/CPU consumer method bodies and unrelated models remain unchanged. QSA graph capture, capture-grid, sort and connector changes are outside this PR.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. Eligible Qwen3.8 Flash Next MRV2 configurations use the synchronization optimization automatically, with no configuration switch. Other models keep their existing behavior. The eligibility guards and initialized-lifetime policy remain in place.

### How was this patch tested?

- Eight regression functions, 21 parameterized cases, cover automatic initialization with no opt-in field, text/ordinary multimodal paths, unsupported model/speculator/target/draft consumers, DCP/PCP, sparse offload, realtime media, empty inventories, frozen decisions, copy draining and failure fallback.
- All 21 cases passed against each checkout using the existing local runtime stand-ins. The new default-on initialization regression fails against the previous opt-in implementation. These are local stand-in results, not native runtime or NPU correctness results.
- Ruff check/format, Codespell, Markdownlint CLI 0.45.0, Python compilation, whitespace, forbidden imports, boolean context managers, long-function and package-init checks passed.
- Focused mypy checks for Python 3.10/3.11/3.12 passed for the policy, model state and regression test, with unavailable native imports skipped. The explicit missing-config fallback is retained, resolving the earlier CI union-attr error without reintroducing the opt-in flag.
- Verified the same five-file feature additions on main and release, unchanged from the previously submitted feature delta. Existing branch-specific runner differences are inherited from each base; AscendConfig, KV connector and connector tests match their respective bases. The producer/consumer/eligibility methods and model state are preserved.
- Refreshed the source history onto current upstream bases so CI no longer replays historical connector edits over the upstream finalize_step forwarding. The three actual connector regressions fail against the old main wrapper and pass against the refreshed wrapper with both upstream API stand-ins; the release wrapper remains passing. This is a local stand-in check, not a full native CPU run.
- Native pytest collection is unavailable on this Windows host because Torch is absent. Full `bash format.sh ci` is unavailable because Bash is absent. New native CPU/full-hook CI results are pending this push. Earlier green CI runs validate the previous opt-in revisions, not these updated commits.
- Exact-tree NPU output/cache validation and a controlled performance comparison for the default-on revision remain pre-merge validation.

### Checklist

- [x] Automatic eligible-Qwen policy and fallback regressions.
- [x] Same main/release feature delta; no AscendConfig or connector delta.
- [x] Focused local static and stand-in checks.
- [ ] Updated native CI and exact-tree NPU/performance validation.

AI assistance: OpenAI Codex.
